comparison.derivation: A floating reset-state input draws no more than the sourced maximum leakage.
comparison.reset_state: RM0008 Rev 9 section 8.1.1 (p140): I/O ports in Input Floating mode during and just after reset, JTAG pins PA15/PA13/PB4 pull-up and PA14 pull-down; NRST has its pull-up (DS5319 Table 39).

io_leak_max.detail: Input leakage current(6) VSS <= VIN <= VDD Standard I/Os +-1; VIN = 5 V I/O FT 3
io_leak_max.scope: STM32F103CBU6 UFQFPN48; DS5319 Rev 20; Table 36 Ilkg standard I/Os, VSS <= VIN <= VDD (FT at VIN = 5 V: 3 uA)

supply_max.scope: STM32F103CBU6 UFQFPN48; DS5319 Rev 20; Table 9 VDD standard operating voltage

limits: Reset-state electrical check of one pin with every rail at its sourced recommended maximum: the pin, shorted to ground, must draw only its sourced leakage (floating input) or its sourced pull-up current. Firmware, clocks, peripherals and output drive are not modeled; the leakage term of the hashed pad is zero, so the leakage check bounds the model from above only.
